sources.title: flux1-schnell: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview flux1-schnell is a FP8 quantized text-to-image diffusion model maintained by Comfy-Org. The model operates using latent diffusion with a fixed timestep schedule, designed for fast inference with minimal memory consumption. The key distinguishing feature is the FP8 quantization of model weights, which trades marginal quality loss for substantial reductions in VRAM usage and inference ...
